extraction.name: EgoLife
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset and benchmark (EgoLifeQA) captured from 6 participants living together for one week using Meta Aria glasses, synchronized exocentric GoPro cameras, and mmWave radars, featuring extensive visual-audio narrations, transcripts, and long-context question-answering annotations.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Six volunteers lived together in a custom-designed environment (EgoHouse) over a seven-day period in Beijing to organize an Earth Day party, continuously recording approximately 8 hours of egocentric multimodal video daily using Meta Aria glasses. Concurrently, 15 synchronized GoPro cameras and 2 mmWave radars captured third-person and spatial/motion data. Primary investigators actively monitored participants to maintain engagement. Recordings were taken in 3-hour segments, pausing 1 hour for data upload and storage clearance. A supplementary one-day recording session was also captured in Milan, Italy.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw multimodal data captured from Meta Aria glasses (first-person video, audio, IMU, gaze VRS data), 15 GoPro cameras (third-person view MP4 video), TI IWR6843 mmWave radars with DCA1000 capture boards (raw ADC data), and Asus RT-AX82U WiFi devices (CSI data in the Milan session).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Multi-source data synchronization across Aria glasses and GoPro cameras using the EgoSync codebase; multimodal signal extraction and timestamp alignment; constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detection algorithm on mmWave raw ADC data; AX-CSI platform processing for WiFi channel state information; EgoBlur de-identification to blur faces, bystander faces, and vehicle license plates; audio muting for sensitive conversations; screen masking for sensitive display content; video splitting into 5-minute clips slowed to 0.8x speed for narrations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations consist of transcripts, captions, and QA pairs. Transcripts were initialized with speech recognition (Whisper) and diarization, then human-reviewed and split into 6 individual audible tracks. Captions began as continuous human-spoken narrations on 0.8x speed clips (producing 361K subtitle-like phrases), merged using GPT-4o-mini into 25K coherent sentences, and expanded into visual-audio captions using GPT-4o with representative frames (1 FPS) and transcripts, followed by human verification. For EgoLifeQA, prompts across five categories (EntityLog, EventRecall, HabitInsight, RelationMap, TaskMaster) generated ~100K questions per participant via GPT-4o, filtered and curated by annotators to 500 high-quality multiple-choice QAs per participant (3K total, requiring >=5 min look-back time) with distractor options, required certification length, and audio necessity flags.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Whisper Large v3, Whisper Diarization, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Data has been released for Beijing, while the Milan session will be released and detailed in the upcoming EgoLife blog series. Finding a reliable annotation team took two months and five trials, and this partnership will continue for future EgoLife versions.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Participant faces, bystander faces, spoken conversations, personal activities, screen contents/passwords, and vehicle license plates.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Significant potential to enhance human-AI interaction, personalized assistance, contextual reminders, and quality of life for individuals needing consistent support (e.g., elderly or individuals with cognitive challenges), as well as aiding learning and task tracking in professional settings. Raises concerns regarding user privacy, personal space invasion, and user autonomy, necessitating safeguards and transparency.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: EgoGPT tends to overfit to early observations from Day-1 for identity recognition (e.g., identifying a person based on clothing color observed on Day-1). Dataset has an intentionally narrow setting (single language/scenario focus initially, sacrificing some generalizability).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: EgoGPT's speech understanding is incomplete and struggles with human laughter and emotions; identity recognition is prone to overfitting; EgoRAG single-pass retrieval lacks multi-step iterative reasoning and error resilience; initial dataset focuses heavily on a single house environment and Chinese language context.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Advancing long-context egocentric video understanding, multimodal life assistance, video question answering, video captioning, habit discovery, long-term personal memory retrieval, multi-person social interaction modeling, and instruction tuning.
